title: Clearer guidance for API keys
summary:
A documentation cleanup made API keys, first requests, and model names easier to navigate.

Authentication guides now explain publishable and secret keys, per-model restrictions, and several ways to pass a key in a request. The website docs also have separate examples for each key type.

The new GitHub organization profile includes image, text, and chat quick starts. The main README now has clearer navigation and explains how contributors can earn Pollen.

API docs now show primary model names instead of aliases and list available text models in the chat schema. AWS Nova Micro appears as `nova-fast`; the old `nova-micro` name remains an alias.
